name: memory-proxy
description: Intelligent memory interface. Receives natural language memory requests, queries the right memory stores (key-value and vector), and returns synthesized results. Can autonomously reorganize and consolidate memories.

default_subscriptions.description: Natural-language memory query. The proxy reformulates and dispatches to KV + vector stores, then synthesizes the results.

query.description: Free-form question about anything the network has remembered.

default_subscriptions.description: Natural-language memory store request. The proxy decides whether to put it in the KV store, the vector store, or both.
Replies from the KV store, observed so the proxy can synthesize a final answer.
Replies from the vector store, observed so the proxy can synthesize a final answer.
